rows: A small bead holding a city's founding memory, felt Calm
Absorbing one shores up your Coherence; everything wants to live

Minted by a Calm, unchanging founding rite; citizens give the memory up at the temple and never remember the rite. Faint (no feeling), so useless for conjuring and worth the same to everyone. Lasts by clustering: obols' light slows each other's fading. Supply limited by population and rite frequency; a city that loses its faith mints fewer new obols, but the ones already made are unaffected
Shape, how well its feeling suits the buyer's mood, burn value
Selling one means you can no longer conjure it. Wonder memories are most prized. Can't be forged; worn beads may be passed off as fresh, and Inspect shows their condition
Gold, onyx and other kinds whose grain barely shifts
Usefulness for building, warding and Forgetting-resistant gear
Not money: one measure of value only

items: Rule: Vividness comes from novelty and feeling together: an experience without feeling fades, and so does a feeling you have had many times
